_comment: Rules for .github/scripts/update_images.py. 'tag': regex for image tags, named group 'v' = upstream version (X.Y or X.Y.Z), other named groups = build numbers. 'notes': where upstream release notes live (github owner/repo or gitea host/owner/repo, optional 'tag' regex for release tags); an update is auto-merged unless those notes mention a breaking change. 'always_review': bump kinds that always get a PR. 'automerge': bump kinds merged when no release notes are available. 'primary': the image whose version becomes the app version; other images only bump the -N packaging revision.

docker@cli._comment: docker:<ver>-cli, used by watchdog services; same releases as dind.

tailscale/tailscale._comment: GitHub release notes only link to tailscale.com/changelog, so the semver fallback applies.

aaronleopold/stump@nightly._comment: Stump is pinned to the moving 'nightly' tag: the digest is followed and the version becomes nightly-<UTC time found>.

ghcr.io/kic2807/sideimpactor._comment: Built by .github/workflows/build-sideimpactor.yml from upstream main; tag <commit date YYYY.MMDD.HHMM>-<sha>.

ghcr.io/kic2807/transmission-next-ui._comment: Built by .github/workflows/build-transmission-next-ui.yml from upstream releases; tag <release version>-r<REVISION>. Upstream calls itself early and untested, so minor bumps get a PR.

ghcr.io/immich-app/immich-machine-learni._comment: OpenVINO variant for things-immich-ml. Must match the version of Umbrel's official Immich app, so every update is a PR: merge it once Umbrel's Immich has the same version.

ghcr.io/cleanuparr/cleanuparr._comment: Upstream versioning: a minor release is breaking (database changes, no rollback); patches are fixes and compatible features.

ghcr.io/kic2807/caddy-cloudflare._comment: Built by .github/workflows/build-caddy.yml. Tag <caddy>-cf<caddy-dns/cloudflare>; a plugin-only change is a 'build' bump. Caddy flags breaking changes in its release notes.
